steps.title: Ask Cru what we are doing
steps.body: Cru is now the voice of the whole workbench. Ask "what are we doing?" or "what's next?" and it looks across every project: chats waiting on you first, then what is moving (chats at work, cards in progress, recent commits), then what is next on each board. It keeps learning how you like things, and sets up its own tickers when they would help.
